listing.name: Super Slipsurge
listing.aiSummary: Changes the Slip Surge ability to consume more fuel and allow warping with a slim stream.

description:
Super Slipsurge Mod

Download

Introduction
Change the Generate Slipsurge
— Too lazy to move around hyperspace, so I just made this
— When activated, it consumes a little more fuel and ready for warp
— Maximum Warp punch it using a slim stream
(requires Slip Surge to use, of course)
— Can be stopped by pressing the S key
— Balance is ... just OP mod lol

Roadmap
I plan to add mod settings and various convenience features using lunalib.

Changelog
